identity.title: List of Magical Pokémon Journey volumes

leadText:
This is a list of volumes of the Pokémon manga, Magical Pokémon Journey. There are ten volumes in total, with only 7 volumes released by VIZ Media and the entire series released by Chuang Yi.

 

 

 
 

fr:Liste des volumes de Pikachu Adventures!
it:Elenco dei volumi di Il magico viaggio dei Pokémon
zh:皮卡丘大冒险 我爱PiPiPi单行本列表
